# TK Partners Certified Public Accountant

> TK Partners Certified Public Accountant is a regional CPA firm with offices in Walla Walla and Moses Lake, Washington, serving Eastern Washington. It provides outsourced accounting, tax, and estate and trust services to small businesses, wineries, agricultural operations, restaurants, trustees, and estate administrators. It positions itself as a supportive partner, not just an accountant, with industry specialization, a fixed monthly bookkeeping fee with no billing surprises, and year-round advisory support.
